chain_words.nuance: mildly enjoyable to look at or experience
appealing and likely to draw attention
high degree of visual or artistic beauty
so impressive that it surprises the viewer

explanation: These words all describe something pleasing to look at, but they range from mild pleasantness to an effect that takes the viewer's breath away.

usage_notes.difference: 'Beautiful' describes a general quality of attractiveness; 'stunning' suggests the impression is so strong that it surprises the viewer.
